params.hat_tune: Fundamental of the comb and the partial bank, in semitones.
params.hat_decay: Ring length, 5 ms to 4 s on an exponential taper so the travel reads as linear in perceived length.
params.hat_mat: Material morph: comb, harmonic, membrane, 808 cluster, free bar. Every position between is a plausible percussion timbre.
params.hat_body: Blend from raw excitation to the resonant partials.
params.hat_tone: Brightness. Lowpass below the centre, highpass above it, transparent through the middle.
params.hat_strike: How the hit's energy is spread in time: rattle to the left, one clean strike at the centre, burst cluster to the right.
params.hat_grit: Drive into the kit's shared saturation curve, normalised by this voice's own envelope.

params.volume: Master level for the whole kit.
params.drive: Bus saturation, a static pre-gain — drum-bus glue rather than a limiter.
params.curve: Shared saturation curve. The same choice as Ballast's, which is what makes the two sit together.
params.tone: Bus tilt, plus or minus 12 dB around 1.5 kHz.
params.shape: Kit-wide envelope shape, exponential through to linear.
params.human: Per-hit variation: pitch, decay, drive, level, stereo position and trigger offset.
params.vel_depth: How far velocity moves timbre, not just level.
params.spread: Stereo width of the per-voice pan positions.
params.root: MIDI note of voice 1. The six voices sit on root through root+5.
params.chrom: Which voice plays chromatically above root+12. 0 disables the zone.
params.choke: Choke group: off, voices 1-2, or voices 1-3.
params.kit_decay: Macro: scales every voice's decay, a quarter to four times.
params.bright: Macro: bipolar offset to every voice's tone.
params.warp: Macro: bipolar offset to every voice's material.
